Game Overview

Tic Toc Boom puts players into a hyper-casual experience centered on race against time in Tic Toc Boom, an electrifying arcade thriller. Blast clocks before they tick down to zero, navigating through over 100 enthralling levels packed with cunning obstacles and explosive boss showdowns. Sharpen your reflexes and unleash powerful upgrades as the intensity rises with each passing second.
